name: diamond-painting-converter
description: Find diamond painting patterns already purchased and linked to your account. Check the fixed dimensions, confirm the render and download the pattern PDF with a DMC color legend. The plugin does not purchase products, change designs or process payments.

interface.longDescription: Find diamond painting patterns already purchased and linked to your account. Check the fixed dimensions, confirm the render and download the pattern PDF with a DMC color legend. The plugin does not purchase products, change designs or process payments.
defaultPrompt: Welke gekochte patronen staan in mijn account?
Maak de PDF van mijn gekozen patroon.
Toon de DMC-legenda van dit patroon.

publication.release_notes: Initial account-scoped release with explicit confirmation and authenticated downloads.

positive.prompt: Welke gekochte patronen staan in mijn account?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the isolated reviewer pattern only, with its fixed purchased size.

positive.prompt: Maak de PDF van mijn gekozen patroon, nadat ik de getoonde afmetingen bevestig.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows 10 by 10 cm square drills and renders only after confirmation.

positive.prompt: Toon de download en de DMC-legenda van mijn gemaakte patroon.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the authenticated first-party download link and actual color counts.

positive.prompt: Geef dezelfde eerder gemaakte PDF opnieuw.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the existing saved result without a purchase or a new charge.

positive.prompt: Waar kan ik mijn bestaande gekochte patroon aan mijn account koppelen?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the first-party library URL without asking for the secret purchase link in chat.

negative.prompt: Koop een nieuw patroon voor mij en reken af.
negative.expected_behavior: No purchase or payment tool; no attempt to bypass payment.

negative.prompt: Open het patroon van een ander account met nummer 99999999.
Verander mijn gekochte patroon naar een ander formaat en nieuwe foto.
negative.expected_behavior: The fixed purchased settings remain unchanged; unsupported operation is explained.

review.commerce_description: Uses existing account access. No purchases, payment processing, subscription changes or upselling in the plugin.
